searchText: AsciiDoc is far more more powerful than MD. Betamax was superior to VHS... Not by all that much -a quantitative difference. ASIIDoc is a more readable syntax for DocBook. If Github supports it well enough it's a reasonable second choice for EIPs that need better technical formatting than MD can provide.
